summary: Keep keyboard focus and success announcements stable during transcript image reads, share the bounded cache across retained viewer panes, and keep unsupported attachments non-actionable

schema.detail: No generated client or wire contract changes.

compatibility.detail: The 24-entry/40-MiB limit is shared per data-source/viewer rather than multiplied by retained panes. Final pane release revokes cached URLs. Unsupported references and image types remain plain deferred cards without retry.

recovery.detail: Revert the review correction; no persistent data is changed.
